description: This file defines the Dashlet class used as a base class for creating dashboard widgets in the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties and methods for rendering dashlet headers, footers, icons, options, and auto-refresh capabilities, along with localization support.

classes.name: Dashlet
classes.description: The base class for all dashboard widgets in SuiteCRM, providing common functionality such as rendering headers, footers, icons, auto-refresh, localization, and options management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Dashlet instance with a unique identifier.

methods.name: setConfigureIcon
methods.description: Returns HTML for the configure icon if the dashlet is configurable.

methods.name: setRefreshIcon
methods.description: Returns HTML for the refresh icon if the dashlet is refreshable.

methods.name: setDeleteIcon
methods.description: Returns HTML for the delete icon unless homepage locking is enabled.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Deprecated method, returns an empty string.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML header for the dashlet, including title and control icons.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML footer for the dashlet.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Method intended to be overridden, called to display the dashlet content.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Method intended to be overridden for dashlet configuration options.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Method intended to be overridden for pre-processing before display.

methods.name: processAutoRefresh
methods.description: Generates HTML code for auto-refresh functionality of the dashlet.

methods.name: getAutoRefresh
methods.description: Calculates and returns the auto-refresh interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves dashlet options from request parameters.

methods.name: loadLanguage
methods.description: Loads language strings for the dashlet based on current language settings.

methods.name: storeOptions
methods.description: Stores dashlet options in user preferences.

methods.name: loadOptions
methods.description: Loads dashlet options from user preferences.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Determines if the current user has access to view this dashlet.

methods.name: isAutoRefreshable
methods.description: Indicates whether this dashlet supports auto-refreshing.
